steps.title: Choose PAX7 transcript variant
steps.instruction: Select human PAX7 transcript variant 3 (NM_001135254) and plan to insert the reporter cassette into its 3′ UTR to monitor PAX7.v3 expression.

steps.title: Define 3′ UTR targeting region
steps.instruction: Retrieve the 3′ UTR sequence of PAX7.v3, limit the gRNA design to the last 1,500 bp downstream of predicted miR‑1 family binding sites, and avoid the 5′ UTR unless transcriptional activation cannot be confirmed.

steps.title: Design candidate gRNAs
steps.instruction: Submit the 1,500 bp region to a CRISPR gRNA design tool, pick six 20‑bp gRNAs spread across the region, design corresponding 17‑bp versions (total 12 candidates), and record their sequences for oligo ordering.

steps.title: Order gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Order forward and reverse DNA oligos for each of the 12 candidate gRNAs from IDT or another supplier (see Table 1 for sequences).

steps.title: Prepare cell culture media
steps.instruction:
Prepare the following media according to the listed compositions (store at 4 °C, use within 2 weeks; aliquots can be stored at –20 °C):
• 293 Medium: DMEM high glucose, 10 % FBS, 1 × GlutaMAX (5 mL per 50 mL), 1 × NEAA (5 mL per 50 mL), 1 mM sodium pyruvate (5 mL per 50 mL), optional 50 U/mL pen‑strept (2.5 mL per 50 mL).
• SC Medium (presomitic mesoderm): DMEM/F12‑HEPES, 20 % FBS, 1 % chick embryo extract, 20 ng/mL FGF2 (50 µL of 40 µg/mL stock per 100 mL), optional 50 U/mL pen‑strept.
• hPSC Culture Medium: mTeSR1 basal, 1 × mTeSR1 supplement (5 ×, 100 µL per 100 mL), optional 50 U/mL pen‑strept.
• hPSC Selection Medium: hPSC culture medium + 100 µg/mL G418 (add 1 mL of 10 mg/mL stock per 100 mL).
• Basal Differentiation Medium (BDM): DMEM/F12‑HEPES, 5 % ITS‑G, optional 50 U/mL pen‑strept.
• PSM Promoting Medium: BDM + 3 µM CHIR99021 (15 µL of 20 mM stock per 100 mL).
• SM Promoting Medium: BDM + 200 nM LDN193189 (20 µL of 1 mM stock) + 10 µM SB431542 (20 µL of 50 mM stock).
• DM Promoting Medium: BDM + 10 µM CHIR99021 (50 µL of 20 mM stock) + 20 ng/mL FGF2 (50 µL of 40 µg/mL stock).
• Myo Promoting Medium: DMEM high glucose, 15 % knockout serum replacement, 10 ng/mL recombinant HGF (500 µL of 10 µg/mL stock per 500 mL), 2 ng/mL LONG R3 IGF‑I (50 µL of 20 µg/mL stock per 500 mL), optional 50 U/mL pen‑strept.

steps.title: Clone gRNA expression plasmids (reporter insertion)
steps.instruction: Construct plasmids expressing each candidate gRNA for reporter‑insertion testing.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µg of the gRNA cloning vector (Addgene #41824) and 1 µL (20 U) AflII to a 50 µL restriction digest (water to volume); incubate 37 °C for 1 h.
Purify the linearized vector with the DNA Clean & Concentrator‑5 Kit (or heat‑inactivate at 65 °C for 20 min if not proceeding immediately).

Set up NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly (20 µL total): 0.015 pmol digested vector, 0.075 pmol forward oligo, 0.075 pmol reverse oligo, 10 µL NEBuilder Master Mix, water to 20 µL. Incubate 50 °C for 15 min, keep on ice.
Transform 2 µL assembly into NEB 10‑beta competent E. coli, plate on LB‑agar with kanamycin, incubate 37 °C ~16 h.
Pick 1–3 colonies per construct into 3–5 mL kanamycin LB, shake 37 °C ~16 h.
Mini‑prep plasmid DNA with QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit; mix remaining culture 1:1 with 50 % glycerol and store at –80 °C.
Sequence plasmids using the T7 primer (Table 3) to confirm correct gRNA insertion.
Prepare transfection‑grade plasmid by repeating transformation, growth, and miniprep steps, then store at 4 °C (short‑term) or –20 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Screen gRNAs in 293FT cells
steps.instruction: Assess cutting efficiency of each candidate gRNA in an easy‑to‑transfect line.

substeps.instruction: Maintain 293FT cells in 293 Medium at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; passage before 70‑80 % confluence.
Day –1: seed 75,000 cells cm⁻² into a 24‑well plate.
Day 0: transfect each well with 1 µg total plasmid (0.5 µg Cas9 Addgene #41815 + 0.5 µg gRNA plasmid) using TransIT‑293 at a 3:1 reagent‑to‑DNA (v/w) ratio.
Day 1: replace medium with fresh 293 Medium.
Day 3: harvest cells, extract genomic DNA with DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit; store at –20 °C if needed.

PCR‑amplify the region surrounding each gRNA cut site using Q5 Hot‑Start High‑Fidelity 2× Master Mix (25 µL reaction: 250 ng template, 500 nM each primer, 12.5 µL 2× mix, water to 25 µL). Cycling: 98 °C 30 s; 30 × (98 °C 10 s, 60‑62 °C 20 s, 72 °C 30 s); 72 °C 2 min; hold 4 °C.
Run 5 µL of each PCR on a 2 % TAE agarose gel to verify product size.

Perform Surveyor assay: denature/re‑anneal PCR products (95 °C 10 min; ramp –2 °C/s to 85 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 75 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 65 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 55 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 45 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 35 °C, hold 1 min; –0.3 °C/s to 25 °C, hold 1 min; 4 °C hold). Add 10‑20 ng DNA, 10 % MgCl₂ (0.15 M), 1 µL Surveyor Enhancer, 2 µL Surveyor Nuclease; incubate 42 °C 60 min; stop with 10 % Stop Solution.

Run the digested products on a 2 % agarose gel, identify bands of expected sizes, and calculate indel % using indel % = (1 – √(1 – (B + C)/(A + B + C))) × 100 where A = uncut band intensity, B + C = cleaved band intensities.

steps.title: Secondary gRNA screening in hPSCs
steps.instruction: Test the most efficient gRNAs in H9 hPSCs.

substeps.instruction: Maintain H9 hESCs on Matrigel in hPSC culture medium; change daily; passage at ~70‑80 % confluence with 0.5 mM EDTA (4‑5 min).
Day 0 (nucleofection day): replace medium with fresh medium + 10 µM Y‑27632; incubate 1 h at 37 °C.
Dissociate cells with TrypLE Express (7‑8 min, 37 °C), neutralize with 3 × volume hPSC medium, collect in a 15 mL tube.
Count and aliquot 800,000 cells per nucleofection tube.
Spin 800,000 cells, discard supernatant, resuspend in 100 µL nucleofection solution (82 µL Nucleofector Solution + 18 µL Supplement, P3 Primary Cell 4D‑Nucleofector X Kit).
Add 2 µg Cas9 plasmid + 2 µg gRNA plasmid (or 2 µg pmaxGFP as a transfection control) to the cell suspension.
Electroporate using 4D‑Nucleofector X Unit, program CA‑137 (recommended over CB‑150 for H9).
Immediately add 0.5 mL hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632 to the cuvette, transfer to a Matrigel‑coated 24‑well; add another 0.5 mL medium (same composition).
Day 1: gently shake plate 2‑3 times, then dissociate cells with TrypLE Express and seed into a Matrigel‑coated 6‑well plate in hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632.
Day 2: replace medium with regular hPSC culture medium (no Y‑27632).
Day 3: harvest cells, extract genomic DNA (DNeasy kit), and perform PCR and Surveyor assay as described for 293FT screening (steps 17‑20).
Select gRNAs showing clear Surveyor cleavage (e.g., PAX7 4‑11S, 5‑10L, 6‑9S).

steps.title: Clone PAX7 HDR donor plasmid
steps.instruction: Assemble a donor vector containing left/right homology arms flanking IRES‑eGFP‑PGK‑Neo.

substeps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from H9 cells; PCR‑amplify left HA (~650 bp) using primers PAX7 L‑HA F/R (Table 5) with Q5 mix (50 µL: 100 ng template, 500 nM each primer, 25 µL 2× mix). Cycling: 98 °C 30 s; 30 × (98 °C 10 s, 66 °C 20 s, 72 °C 30 s); 72 °C 2 min; hold 4 °C.
PCR‑amplify right HA (~700 bp) using primers PAX7 R‑HA F/R under identical conditions.
PCR‑amplify the backbone and IRES‑eGFP‑PGK‑Neo cassette from Addgene #48681 using primers that add 20 bp overlaps with the HAs (Table 5). Reaction volume 50 µL, same cycling but extension 90 s.
Run all four PCR products on a 1.5 % TAE agarose gel, excise correct bands, and purify with MinElute Gel Extraction Kit (or clean‑up with DNA Clean & Concentrator‑5 if no smear).
Submit each purified fragment for Sanger sequencing with the primers listed in Table 3 to verify sequence integrity.
Assemble the four fragments in a NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly (20 µL total): 0.04 pmol each fragment + 10 µL NEBuilder Master Mix; incubate 50 °C 1 h, keep on ice.
Transform 2 µL assembly into NEB 10‑beta competent cells, plate on LB‑agar with ampicillin, incubate 37 °C ~16 h.
Pick colonies, grow in 3‑5 mL ampicillin LB, miniprep plasmid DNA, and verify junctions by Sanger sequencing using primers M13R, EGFP‑N, Neo‑F, etc. (Table 3).
Prepare transfection‑grade plasmid by repeating transformation, growth, and using the EndoFree Plasmid Maxi Kit; store at 4 °C (short‑term) or –20 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Generate reporter hPSC clones with G418 selection
steps.instruction: Knock‑in the PAX7‑IRES‑eGFP‑PGK‑Neo cassette into H9 cells and isolate single‑cell clones.

substeps.instruction: Nucleofect H9 cells as in the secondary screening step, delivering 2 µg Cas9 plasmid, 2 µg PAX7 6‑9S gRNA plasmid, and 2 µg HDR donor plasmid (total 6 µg DNA).
Culture nucleofected cells 24 h in hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632.
Day 1: dissociate cells from the 24‑well, seed into a 6‑well plate with hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632.
Day 2: replace medium with regular hPSC culture medium (no Y‑27632) to allow expression of the Neo resistance gene.
Day 3: start selection by adding G418 to a final concentration of 100 µg/mL (hPSC selection medium).
Continue daily medium changes with G418 for 4‑5 days; monitor for massive cell death and the emergence of small resistant colonies (2‑3 cells per cluster).
≈1 week after selection start, manually pick individual colonies (~200‑400 cells) with a P200 tip and transfer each to a separate Matrigel‑coated 24‑well plate.
Feed colonies daily with hPSC selection medium; when colonies become large enough, split to Matrigel‑coated 12‑well plates (0.5 mM EDTA, 3‑5 min).
After colonies reach 70‑80 % confluence in 12‑well, split again to 6‑well plates; continue daily feeding.
When 6‑well cultures are 70‑80 % confluent, freeze aliquots in hPSC medium + 10 % DMSO (one 6‑well per cryovial) and store in liquid nitrogen.
At each split (24‑→12‑well and 12‑→6‑well) set aside cells for genomic DNA extraction (DNeasy kit).

Genotype clones: PCR with external primers (WT locus) to assess heterozygosity, and junctional primers (external + internal) to confirm correct integration (Table 6). Run products on 0.8 % agarose, excise correct bands, and submit for Sanger sequencing.

steps.title: Remove PGK‑Neo cassette with Tat‑Cre
steps.instruction: Excise the antibiotic resistance cassette from a validated heterozygous reporter clone.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the chosen reporter clone (e.g., clone #3) and culture for 1‑2 passages in hPSC medium to ensure healthy morphology.

When colonies reach 70‑80 % confluence, dissociate with TrypLE Express, and seed onto Matrigel‑coated vessels at four densities: 6,250; 12,500; 25,000; and 50,000 cells cm⁻² in hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632.
Next day, replace medium with hPSC medium containing 200 µg/mL recombinant Tat‑Cre; incubate 3 h at 37 °C, then replace with regular hPSC medium (no G418).
During the first week post‑Tat‑Cre, most cells die; surviving cells form small individual colonies suitable for picking.
Pick surviving colonies (≈23 initially), transfer each to a 24‑well plate, and expand using the same passaging scheme as in the reporter‑clone establishment (24‑→12‑→6‑well, then freeze).

Extract genomic DNA from each expanded clone and perform PCR to confirm: (i) loss of the PGK‑Neo cassette (3′ junction primers IN‑FW/EX‑RV #2), (ii) correct 5′ junction (EX‑FW #2/IN‑RV), and (iii) absence of random vector backbone integration (AmpR F/R).
Sequence the PCR products to verify precise cassette removal.
Select clones that are G418‑sensitive (no growth in 100 µg/mL G418) and have clean junctions (e.g., clones #3‑13 and #3‑22).

steps.title: Validate reporter by artificial PAX7 activation
steps.instruction: Test GFP reporter response using dCas9‑VPR‑mediated activation of the endogenous PAX7 promoter.

substeps.instruction: Clone the four PAX7 promoter‑targeting gRNAs into expression plasmids using the same cloning workflow as for reporter‑insertion gRNAs (steps 1‑11 of gRNA cloning).
For each reporter clone (#3‑13, #3‑22) and for parental H9 cells, seed single cells (25,000 cells cm⁻²) in Matrigel‑coated vessels with hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632.
Day 1: switch to PSM‑promoting medium and culture 2 days (change daily).
Day 3: dissociate and reseed at 75,000 cells cm⁻² in SC‑promoting medium.

Day 4: transfect using ViaFect (24‑well): 0.25 µg dCas9‑VPR plasmid + 0.25 µg each gRNA plasmid (total 1 µg DNA) with 1.5 µL ViaFect (3:1 v/w). Include a negative control (dCas9‑VPR + empty gRNA vector) and a mixed‑gRNA condition (0.0625 µg of each of the four gRNAs).
Culture with daily SC‑medium changes; 2 days post‑transfection harvest cells.
Extract total RNA (RNeasy Plus Micro Kit), synthesize cDNA (iScript Reverse Transcription Supermix), and perform qPCR for PAX7 (SsoAdvanced Universal SYBR Green).
For reporter clones, 3 days post‑transfection dissociate cells, add DAPI (0.5‑1 µg/mL), and sort GFP⁺ and GFP⁻ populations on a flow cytometer.

Cytospin sorted cells onto Superfrost Plus slides (Shandon Double Cytofunnel, 1,000 rpm 5 min), fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde, and immunostain for PAX7 protein using standard IF protocol; image and quantify PAX7⁺ cells.
Extract RNA from the sorted fractions and repeat qPCR for PAX7 and GFP to confirm reporter activation.

steps.title: Validate reporter during myogenic differentiation
steps.instruction: Differentiate reporter hPSCs to skeletal muscle progenitors and assess GFP expression.

substeps.instruction: Day –1: dissociate reporter colonies (70‑80 % confluent) with TrypLE Express, seed at 12,500‑25,000 cells cm⁻² on Matrigel in hPSC medium + 10 µM Y‑27632 (also seed parental H9 as a GFP‑negative control).
Day 0: wash once with PBS, add PSM‑promoting medium (CHIR99021 3 µM).
Day 1: refresh PSM medium (cells are at primitive streak stage).
Day 2: wash PBS, add SM‑promoting medium (LDN193189 200 nM + SB431542 10 µM) – cells become posterior PSM.
Day 3: refresh SM medium (anterior PSM).
Day 4: wash PBS, add DM‑promoting medium (CHIR99021 10 µM + FGF2 20 ng/mL) – cells become somite.
Day 5: refresh DM medium.
Day 6: wash PBS, add Myo‑promoting medium (DM + 10 % knockout serum replacement, 10 ng/mL HGF, 2 ng/mL LONG R3 IGF‑I).
Day 8 onward: refresh Myo medium every other day (increase volume to 3 mL per 6‑well if medium turns yellow).

≈4 weeks: harvest differentiated cultures. Incubate with 2 mg/mL Collagenase IV in DMEM/F12 at 37 °C for ~5 min, remove enzyme, wash PBS, then incubate with TrypLE Express 6‑8 min at 37 °C. Triturate gently.
Add FACS buffer (≥2× TrypLE volume), triturate, filter through 100 µm then 70 µm strainers, centrifuge 300 × g 6 min, resuspend pellet in FACS buffer, count cells.
Add DAPI to a final concentration of 0.5‑1 µg/mL, keep on ice.
FACS sort GFP⁺ and GFP⁻ fractions (10,000‑20,000 cells per sample).
Cytospin sorted cells onto slides (Shandon Double Cytofunnel, 1,000 rpm 5 min), fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde, immunostain for PAX7, image, and quantify.
Extract RNA from remaining sorted cells, generate cDNA, and perform qPCR for GFP and PAX7 (normalized to GAPDH).
